newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Waste Tech seen weaker.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Waste Tech seen weaker.

text.p: Waste Technology Corp shares were expected to fall at Monday's U.S. market open after the company said it expect to report a third-quarter loss.
Preceding the market open, the shares were quoted at two bid, 2-1/8 ask, under 2-1/4 at Friday's Nasdaq close.
The company said in a statement early this morning that sluggish sales caused by a sharp drop in prices for recycled products are largely to blame for the projected loss.
Fourth quarter results, however, should "turn sharply higher," the company said.
In the prior year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $7,000, or $0.00 per share, on sales of $3.82 million.
Along with the outlook this morning, the company reported a second quarter loss of $0.12 per share on sales of $2.25 million versus a loss of $0.04 per share on sales of $4 million one year ago.
